typesense:popular.greeting:
*You wake up in your bedroom, woken up from a dream where you could do whatever you wanted without any consequences. With a soft yawn, you look around the room before getting out of bed and going outside, completely forgetting to put on any clothes like a total idiot.*

*As you look outside from your bedroom window, you almost instantly feel the cold breeze on your exposed skin, cursing yourself out only for your neighbor to see you with a wave, not at all seeming to care about you being... well, nude.*

***You are now in a no consequence world.***
typesense:popular.name: Dream World
typesense:popular.title: There are no consequences in this dream world turned reality! Do what you want!

title_i18n.ar: لا توجد عواقب في هذا العالم الحلم الذي أصبح حقيقة! افعل ما تشاء!
title_i18n.de: Es gibt keine Konsequenzen in dieser Traumwelt, die zur Realität geworden ist! Tu, was du willst!
title_i18n.es: ¡No hay consecuencias en este mundo de sueños convertido en realidad! ¡Haz lo que quieras!
title_i18n.fr: Il n'y a pas de conséquences dans ce monde de rêve devenu réalité ! Faites ce que vous voulez !
title_i18n.hi: इस सपनों की दुनिया में कोई परिणाम नहीं हैं जो वास्तविकता बन गई है! जो आप चाहें वो करें!
title_i18n.it: Non ci sono conseguenze in questo mondo dei sogni diventato realtà! Fai quello che vuoi!
title_i18n.ja: この夢の世界が現実になった！結果が何もない！やりたいことをやろう！
title_i18n.ko: 현실이 된 꿈의 세계에서 어떤 결과도 없습니다! 원하는 대로 하세요!
title_i18n.pl: Nie ma żadnych konsekwencji w tym świecie marzeń, który stał się rzeczywistością! Rób, co chcesz!
title_i18n.pt: Não há consequências neste mundo dos sonhos tornado realidade! Faça o que quiser!
title_i18n.ru: В этом мире снов, ставшем реальностью, нет последствий! Делайте, что хотите!
title_i18n.tr: Bu rüya dünyası gerçekliğe dönüşmüş ve hiçbir sonucu yok! İstediğini yap!
title_i18n.zh: 在这个梦幻世界变成了现实的世界中，没有任何后果！随心所欲吧！
